doc: Multiply by `-1` if the leading coefficient is negative, otherwise do nothing.
name: Lean.Omega.positivize
typeText: Prod.{0, 0} Lean.Omega.Constraint Lean.Omega.Coeffs → Prod.{0, 0} Lean.Omega.Constraint Lean.Omega.Coeffs

source.code:
/-- Multiply by `-1` if the leading coefficient is negative, otherwise do nothing. -/
noncomputable def positivize (p : Constraint × Coeffs) : Constraint × Coeffs :=
  positivize? p |>.getD p
